name: theme-yaml-extension
description: A theme file named with a `.yaml` extension, which the app recognises as a theme but Asciidoctor-PDF does not accept as a theme filename — its loader appends `-theme.yml` to anything not already ending in `.yml`, fails to find the file, and REVERTS TO THE DEFAULT THEME with only a log line. The renderer mounts a `.yml` alias so the author's chosen filename keeps working. The reference was produced by the canonical toolchain from the identical theme under a `.yml` name, so this passes only when the alias makes the two renders agree.
